The equation is shown.
2HgO  2Hg + O
Why is this a reduction reaction?

options.text: The products weigh less than the reactants.
There are fewer reactants than products.
There is a gain of oxygen.
There is a loss of oxygen.

questions.questionText:
Element E is a metal in Group I of the Periodic Table and element G is a non-metal in Group VII.
Both of these elements form oxides.
Which statement about their oxides is correct?

options.text: Both oxides are acidic.
Both oxides are basic.
The oxide of E is acidic and the oxide of G is basic.
The oxide of G is acidic and the oxide of E is basic.

questions.questionText:
Lead(II) sulfate is an insoluble salt.
Which method is suitable for obtaining pure solid lead(II) sulfate?

options.text: Mix aqueous lead(II) nitrate and aqueous potassium sulfate, heat to evaporate all of the water, collect the solid and then wash and dry it.
Mix aqueous lead(II) nitrate and aqueous potassium sulfate, filter, collect the filtrate, crystallise, then wash and dry the crystals.
Mix aqueous lead(II) nitrate and dilute sulfuric acid, filter, then wash and dry the residue.
Titrate aqueous lead(II) hydroxide with dilute sulfuric acid, crystallise, then wash and dry the crystals.

They have six electrons in the outer electron shells of their atoms.

questions.questionText:
An example of sacrificial protection is the fitting of zinc blocks to the outside of a ship’s steel hull.
Which statement explains why zinc is used to protect the iron in the steel from rusting?

options.text: Zinc is more reactive than iron so it loses electrons more easily.
Zinc is less reactive than iron so it loses electrons more easily.
Zinc is more reactive than iron so it gains electrons more easily.
Zinc is less reactive than iron so it gains electrons more easily.

options.text: Alloys are harder than pure metals because they contain strong intermolecular forces.

questions.questionText:

The copper foil reacts to give a black solid.
The aluminium foil does not react.

Aluminium is below copper in the reactivity series.
Copper reacts with moisture in the air, but aluminium does not.
Copper reacts with nitrogen in the air, but aluminium does not.

questions.questionText:
Nitrogen monoxide, NO, and carbon monoxide, CO, are both removed from the exhaust gases of
a car by a catalytic converter.
Which statement describes how nitrogen monoxide and carbon monoxide are removed by a
catalytic converter?

Nitrogen monoxide and carbon monoxide are both oxidised.
Nitrogen monoxide is oxidised and carbon monoxide is reduced.
Nitrogen monoxide is reduced and carbon monoxide is oxidised.
